original_test_intent: Verify that the BMC Sensors page loads correctly and exposes the customer-required CPU, DIMM, HDD, PCIe, PSU and FAN records with correct identity, values, units, status, thresholds and freshness.
original_method: Bind the BMC/UI version, capture the complete read-only Sensors view or supported structured API, normalize every required field and compare it with the customer coverage matrix and vendor label-to-device schema.
manual_activity: The owner supplies the customer coverage matrix and semantics; an operator may capture UI-only fields while automation collects, normalizes and compares all six categories.
required_inputs: Expected units, thresholds and status values
Rules for absent, disabled, stale and non-threshold records
safety_requirements: Do not change thresholds, fan curves, power or BMC settings
Do not add workload or thermal stimulus
Stop on missing categories or unexpected fault
No automatic retry or hardware PASS claim
agent_execution_scope: Capture the complete Sensors UI or supported structured response
Extract label, association, value, unit, status, threshold and freshness
Compare every required record and report missing/duplicate/stale/mismatched entries
Do not control sensors or decide the verdict
engineer_actions: Supply the customer matrix and schema
Define state, unit, threshold and freshness rules

command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the protected BMC WebUI/API as primary evidence; validated SDR data may cross-check mapped fields but cannot replace missing customer categories.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All six categories, login requirement and 5/5-minute fields are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Produce a category/device-keyed coverage matrix with raw capture, values, units, status, thresholds and freshness.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds objective field semantics and complete category accounting.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; two CEM sensors or aggregate SDR output cannot satisfy the six-category UI case.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: An incomplete or mislabeled dashboard can conceal thermal, power, storage or device faults.

project_override_considerations: The project may mark unsupported or absent records not applicable only through the approved customer matrix and actual topology; every omission and UI/API equivalence must be explicit.
expected_evidence: Customer coverage matrix and vendor label map
Complete UI/category captures or structured responses
Relevant preserved events and no-mutation audit

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Row 1497 consistently defines a six-category BMC Sensors view; duplicate row 775 is isolated by variant and remains a CEM thermal case.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The customer matrix, schema and state rules are finite project/package inputs; after supply, read-only capture and comparison are feasible.

review_improvement: Restores all six categories, eliminates copied CEM stimulus and makes UI coverage, freshness and field correctness objectively reviewable.
independent_technical_reasoning: The requested dashboard scope is explicit, but `customer defined` prevents a verdict without the project oracle. Since that oracle and schema are finite inputs and the operation is read-only, REQUIRES is the correct readiness class.
